subject: Integration challenge packet — delivery, deadlines, and reviewer slots
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Martin <sophia.martin@gmail.com>
Cc: TalentOps Recruiter <recruiter@talentops.io>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Integration challenge packet — delivery, deadlines, and reviewer slots

Hi Sophia,

Thanks again for interviewing with the Redwood Inference team. As discussed, please find attached the integration challenge packet. It should take ~4–6 hours and focuses on a small frontend integration and an API design write-up. Deliverables and submission instructions are in the PDF.

Key dates and ask:
- Deadline for completed submission: 2026-09-03 23:59 PT (submit as a zipped repo).
- How to submit: reply to this thread and attach a single ZIP named lastname_firstname_solution.zip, or upload to the Drive link below and paste the link in your reply.
- Acceptance criteria: see rubric (attached). The reviewers will be engineering ICs and one engineer+PM pairing for cross-functional feedback.

Attachments: integration_challenge.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB); rubric-review-sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/packet/integration_challenge_2026

Questions you might have: scope clarifications, allowed libraries, or time-boxing guidance — please ask here and we’ll respond within one business day.

Best of luck — looking forward to seeing what you build.

—
Jasmine Liu
Talent Acquisition, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
From: Sophia Martin <sophia.martin@gmail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: TalentOps Recruiter <recruiter@talentops.io>
Date: 2026-08-29T13:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration challenge packet — delivery, deadlines, and reviewer slots

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks — got the packet and rubric. Quick question: for the API write-up, are we expected to include sequence diagrams or is a simple endpoint spec + rationale sufficient? Also: are we allowed to use a lightweight UI framework (e.g., Svelte) or should we stick to React?

Thanks,
Sophia

>

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Reviewer scheduling: Sophia Martin (frontend role) — proposed slots + rubric

Team — looping you in to schedule reviewers for Sophia's integration challenge. She submitted her availability earlier in the loop and the deadline is 2026-09-03 EOD. Proposed reviewer plan:

- Primary reviewer (code & integration): Marissa — functional review + run locally (aim for 48-hour turnaround).
- Secondary reviewer (API design & architecture): Karthik — API spec and edge-case feedback.
- Cross-functional reviewer (product): Grace — product/impact assessment and clarity on trade-offs.

I've attached the rubric and a checklist for local testing. Can you confirm you can cover the review by 2026-09-05? If you prefer different timing, tell me the earliest you can review. We'll slot final moderation and debrief on 2026-09-07 (30 minutes).

Attachments: rubric-review-sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
Drive link to candidate submission (will replace once submitted): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/packet/integration_challenge_2026

Thanks — Jasmine

Jasmine — I'm good to take primary reviewer. I'll block 9/5 10:00–12:00 PT for running the app and writing notes. If the candidate's submission needs dependency help, ping me and I can spin up an environment.

Date: 2026-08-31T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration challenge packet — delivery, deadlines, and reviewer slots

Hi Sophia — thank you for the upload (received via Drive and attached ZIP).

Attachments: sophia_solution.zip (ZIP, 2.9MB)

To answer your question from earlier: a concise endpoint spec with a short rationale is sufficient; diagrams are optional bonus. You may use Svelte or React — we care more about clarity and testability than the particular framework.

Next steps:
- Marissa will run the app and comment on integration and code quality (review targeted 2026-09-05).
- Karthik will evaluate the API write-up for correctness and edge cases.
- Grace will provide product-level feedback.

We'll convene a 30-min debrief on 2026-09-07 11:00 PT to align feedback and finalize hire recommendation. Please let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Talent Acquisition, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
